triples.tail_surface: vessel is on even keel and either upright or listed 5 degrees on either side
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 船舶平龙骨且正浮或向任一舷横倾5度
triples.evidence_text: Bilge pumping systems are to be capable of draining the spaces when the vessel is on even keel and either upright or listed 5 degrees on either side.

triples.tail_surface: self-priming type or connected to a priming system
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 自吸式或连接至引水系统
triples.evidence_text: Where centrifugal pumps are installed, they are to be of the self-priming type or connected to a priming system.

triples.head_surface: Bilge lines in machinery spaces other than emergency suctions
triples.head_canonical_zh: 机舱内除应急吸口外的舱底管路
triples.tail_surface: fitted with strainers, easily accessible from the floor plates
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 装设滤器且易于从花钢板处接近
triples.evidence_text: Bilge lines in machinery spaces other than emergency suctions are to be fitted with strainers, easily accessible from the floor plates

triples.head_surface: open ends of the bilge lines in holds and other compartments
triples.head_canonical_zh: 货舱及其他舱室舱底管路开口端
triples.tail_surface: fitted with suitable strainers having an open area of not less than three (3) times the area of the suction pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 装设流通面积不小于吸入管面积三倍的合适滤器
triples.evidence_text: The open ends of the bilge lines in holds and other compartments are to be fitted with suitable strainers having an open area of not less than three (3) times the area of the suction pipe.

triples.tail_surface: located in positions which are accessible at all times for maintenance under ordinary operating conditions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 布置在正常营运条件下随时可接近进行维护的位置
triples.evidence_text: Bilge manifolds and valves in connection with bilge pumping are to be located in positions which are accessible at all times for maintenance under ordinary operating conditions.
The line within the tank is to be installed with expansion bends.
